notablePrerequisites:
Spawning Grounds attached to any Forest you control.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the land with Spawning Grounds attached by tapping it, creating a 5/5 Beast creature token.
The Beast enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land with Spawning Grounds attached.
Repeat.
